notes: Depop (E9) operated through FY2025, but on February 15, 2026 Etsy agreed to sell it to eBay (expected close Q2 2026), and it will become a discontinued operation. Its loss would not change any theme score. Reverb (musical instrument marketplace) was sold June 2, 2025 and Elo7 in 2023; both are past and not scored. Active Etsy sellers declined year over year after the 2024 seller set-up fee. Seller Census figures (e.g., 89% businesses of one, 59% sold for the first time on Etsy) come from a 2024 survey and were not used as indicators. The CERF+ $2,000 disaster grants to sellers, fee deferrals for nearly 77,000 sellers, and a pilot grant to the River Arts District (over 550 artists) are current activities that support Creativity/Community/Entrepreneurship. They were not recorded as evidence because their only complete-sentence quotes are well over 40 words, and they would not change any score. E3's $3.4 million in donations and $30 million Impact Investment Fund may overlap with E2 (Uplift Fund grants) and E4/E5 (Impact Investment Fund loans), so watch for double counting. Etsy Insider loyalty program is a beta. The Item 7 excerpt only repeats the Item 1 overview sentence. Cross-cultural was scored 3 based mainly on the supplier diversity dollar figure; ERGs alone would score 2.
